Vik selected the recorded next repairs with “Okay that's fine, let's move on please” after the v2 two-binding measurement. W1.8.4.4 remains in Implementation. Sol/high handled signature-path scheduling; Terra/high handled reference storage; the primary owned design, integration, review and closeout. No Astra subagents or new agent benchmark trials were used.

Normal retrieval now prioritizes one representative supported input-type path per selected callable, then resumes ordinary family interleaving. It prefers the first authored input with a supported contract dependency and its first authored dependency, otherwise the first supported direct input. Explicit pairs retain precedence. A shared admitted-neighborhood cache preserves the single neighbor allowance across early and ordinary stages; only successful proof/packing transitions advance paths. TypeScript role checking parses the bounded indexed signature once per callable and selects its outer structural parameter field. Generic constraints/body annotations are excluded. Unsupported multiline signatures and ambiguous nested type_argument roles remain ordinary edges; no extraction-schema expansion or guessed role is claimed.

Normal source_ref/next_source_ref strings now default to deterministic 30-character handles backed by a bounded per-repository SQLite cache in the configured namespace. Full canonical repo/path/hash/extent/offset values remain inside Loci. Only final successful response references are atomically persisted. Limits are8192 records and8MiB logical payload; SQLite overhead is separate. Exact locator identity survives process restart while retained. Unknown/evicted references require fresh retrieval; collisions/corruption fail closed. Legacy encoded locators remain readable. Repository isolation, eligible-source checks, current index/live hashes, containment, ordered offsets, UTF8 boundaries and8192/16384-byte paging/output limits remain. These are not authorization credentials.

Primary review corrected real pre-acceptance gaps: priority initially bypassed/repeated neighbor allowances and could advance failed steps; a string-parenthesis check misclassified a generic constraint; all contract branches then crowded out required browser calls. Shared caps, accepted transitions, structural syntax and a single representative priority path resolved those gaps. This is a bounded workflow repair, not evidence that the old parser or reference rejection was broken.

66 distinct directly relevant tests passed, including a fresh stdio process reading the same persisted handle. Final isolated fixed-source checks preserve all638 files/no extras: function-only16268 bytes, richer query14846, explicit pair16161, binding file16162, browser16245 and renderer15523. Both required function->Options->Binding edges and prior browser/renderer call controls retain complete linked proof. All source hashes/spans validate. The function's4468 bytes reconstruct in one page and the binding file's14082 bytes in two pages. The ordering repair was also demonstrated with legacy long references before integration. All45/28/46 historical frozen artifact inputs remain unchanged; new selected product/installed-instruction changes are separate.

One actual host function-only retrieve still returns the exact full old v2 result:15932 bytes, old three relationships and284/280/291/280-character item references. The loaded host requires a restart; local/stdin checks do not establish activation. Next W1.8.4.4 is restart Codex, then verify the same actual-host function-only request and short-reference reads. The selected local implementation is done. No new savings/uptake claim or additional provider comparison: the previous479060-token median,1.9216x baseline input failure, strict-fact/reviewer-comparability caveats and full-workload gap remain. Any new campaign needs selection and a pre-outcome freeze.

replacements.new:
## Current Orientation

The ordinary graph-adoption Objective remains in Implementation. Normal
retrieval runs graph policy deterministically. The earlier named-anchor/type-proof
repair at `44d1074` passed actual restarted-host acceptance at `b9272f2`.

Vik selected the next two workflow repairs after the separately frozen v2
two-binding comparison. Both are implemented and locally accepted: function-only
lookup now prioritizes one supported representative input-type path, and normal
source continuation uses persistent 30-character references. Complete proof,
repository/hash/extent checks and fixed budgets remain. Unsupported signature
roles remain explicit; a short reference still needs exact reuse and may expire.

**Next: W1.8.4.4 — restart Codex, then verify the same function-only request
and short-reference reads through the actual host.** All 66 distinct relevant
tests and six retained-source checks pass, preserving all 638 files and the
browser/renderer call controls. The actual host still returns the full exact old
v2 result, with long references and no input-options path. This is a concrete
activation boundary; local and fresh-stdio results do not prove that the loaded
host has activated the repair. No new provider comparison or savings claim follows.

The completed v2 comparison remains negative on input cost. Both fresh agents
found and invoked Loci, both received complete positive graph context, and one
received the required binding type proof. Median input was **479,060 tokens,
1.9216 times the original baseline**: 34.1% above the previous repaired pair and
29.4% below the original 2.7236-times regression. Visible bytes and elapsed time
pass their unchanged 1.25 limits; input fails. Both attempts used 11 outer
rounds versus a baseline median of 5.5. Cached input contributes 428,544 of the
median total; these two samples establish no billed-dollar or graph-only effect.

Both core contract/view answers are source-correct. Strict original-fact scores
are 2/3 and 1/3: both omit the named options contract, and one leaves the
public-barrel view re-export unstated. Older frozen reviewers credited the
options clause more generously; individual fact counts are not a calibrated
quality trend. Bare-view/runtime and model-reliance qualifications remain.

The retained failures motivate the selected repairs: both first queries named
only `captureCommandResult` and missed its input-options path, and both agents
altered fully delivered valid long references. Exact reuse succeeded; no bad
issuance, broken parser or clipping defect was established. The new local
function-only result contains the complete function-to-options-to-binding path.

Delivery-v4's 30 prelaunch checks and complete nested-JSON/same-call provenance
remain historical evidence. All 45/28/46 frozen artifact inputs are unchanged.
Further provider trials need separate selection and a pre-outcome freeze;
binding-only results cannot close broader ordinary-value acceptance.

See [the selected workflow repair](./sources/loci-ordinary-workflow-repair-2026-09-15.md),
[the completed two-task measurement](./sources/loci-binding-discovery-measurement-2026-09-15.md),
[earlier restarted-host activation](./sources/loci-named-anchor-host-activation-2026-09-15.md)
and [the previous repaired pair](./sources/loci-live-repair-binding-measurement-2026-09-15.md).
Use the current [ordinary adoption Objective](http://127.0.0.1:27247/objectives/obj_47c29425d32907d2bde961f1fd313970?repository=%2FUsers%2Fbrummerv%2Floci).
Manifest owns planning and implementation; use card IDs and concrete next actions
in user-facing updates.
